title: SchemaSnapshot
description: Contract 1 (FlowDesk Chat V2). Declarative, versioned specification of a service intake flow. Produced by the schema-graph compiler (C1) from a Memgraph flow definition, consumed by the interpreter graph (C4) and the DraftSR service (C2). Flow-as-data: this snapshot IS the program the universal interpreter executes; conditionality is expressed as tref conditions on slots, never as branch-merge topology (CODEX-RULE-076).

serviceId.description: ServiceCatalogItem.code this flow fulfils. Matches the serviceId resolve.search returns for type=SERVICE. Widened (I-4) to accept the REAL Altiora catalog: codes run to 6 segments and single-character segments occur (e.g. EO-HR-SA-SS-ISP, EO-HR-SP-G5WP-G4VR). The previous `(-[A-Z0-9]{2,6}){1,3}` rejected 75 of the 79 real requestable services; the legacy fixture codes (IT-HW-LAP, SEC-ACC-BADGE, …) still validate.

version.description: Monotonic snapshot version. Mirrors the GraphVersion of the source flow definition.

phases.description: Ordered dialog phases. Slots are gathered phase-by-phase. Fixed vocabulary for V2.

slots.description: Ordered slot list. A slot is one unit of information the flow must gather. Order within a phase is the ask order when no dependsOn overrides it.

presentation.description: SCH-001. Fields the Altiora schema has that are NOT questions — sections, dividers, headings, static paragraphs, labels. Carried so the snapshot is a translation of the schema rather than a selection from it: the wizard renders these, and a request built from a schema we had only partly read cannot be reconciled with what the user will see. Deliberately outside `slots`, because every queue in the interpreter reads `slots` and a paragraph of static text there would be asked as a question.

dictionaryEntityId.description: A presentation field can be dictionary-backed: Altiora autofills a `label` from one and displays the resolved text (DICT_AUTOFILL_FIELD_TYPES).

handlerRef.description: OrganizationUnit.code of the default handler, or a resolverRef token. Optional — routing may resolve it at runtime.

fieldIdMapping.description: slotId → the original Altiora FormField.id. Present only on snapshots materialized from an Altiora form (IP-1). slotId is sanitized to this contract's pattern, but a ticket's FormDataJson is keyed by Altiora's own field id, so submit (IP-3) needs the way back. Duplicates the per-slot altioraFieldId as a whole-snapshot lookup, keeping the snapshot self-sufficient.

altioraOusId.description: Altiora OrganizationUnitServiceId this form was materialized from. The stable cache key: it never changes for a given service+provider+scope, unlike the schema row id.

contentHash.description: SHA256 of the source Altiora SchemaJson, as reported by GET /api/ServiceDistribution/{ousId}/schema/version. The cache-invalidation key.

sourceFieldCount.description: SCH-001. How many fields the Altiora schema had. Paired with translatedFieldCount so a materializer that stopped understanding part of its input is a visible number rather than a required field nobody is ever asked for.

translatedFieldCount.description: SCH-001. slots + presentation. Equal to sourceFieldCount when the translation is complete.

slotId.description: Stable identifier, unique within the snapshot. Key used in DraftSR.slots.

type.description: Value type. 'enum' requires presentOptions. 'location'/'user' are resolved via resolverRef. 'text' is free-form multi-line (e.g. justification).

required.description: Whether the slot must be filled before SR submission. A required slot may still be skipped when its trefCondition evaluates false.

phase.description: Phase this slot belongs to. MUST be present in the snapshot-level phases array.

trefCondition.description: Optional tref-filter expression over DraftSR state. When present and false, the slot is skipped (CODEX-RULE-076: conditionality via tref, never branch-merge). Example: 'service.approvalRequired == true'.

requiredWhen.description: Optional tref expression making `required` conditional. The slot is required-now when it is visible AND (required OR requiredWhen evaluates true) — visibility always dominates, so an invisible slot is never required. Separate from trefCondition because visibility and obligation are independent: Altiora's set_required rule can make a visible optional field mandatory without revealing anything.

optionFilters.description: Optional conditional narrowing of an enum's presentOptions (Altiora's filter_options rule). Filters are evaluated in order and the first matching one wins; when none match, the full presentOptions stand. Without this, the chat would offer choices the target system rejects on submit.

condition.description: tref expression; when true this filter applies.

include.description: Whitelist — only these option values remain. Values must exist in presentOptions.

exclude.description: Blacklist — these option values are removed. Values must exist in presentOptions.

altioraFieldId.description: The original Altiora FormField.id this slot was materialized from, when it differs from (or matches) the sanitized slotId. Carried so submit (IP-3) can key FormDataJson the way Altiora expects.

resolverRef.description: Optional resolve.search / directory resolver token for location/user/enum-from-catalog slots. Absent for plain scalar slots.

presentOptions.description: Closed set of choices for type=enum. Rendered as choices[] in the WAIT_FOR_INPUT prompt.

lov.description: List-of-values source for a dictionary-backed field (Altiora's dynamic `select`/`lookup`, whose options are NOT embedded in the schema — spec §6b). The materializer (I-4a) captures this durable descriptor; the LOV baker (I-4b) resolves it via POST /api/FormLookup/values and upgrades the slot to type=enum with the resolved presentOptions, stamping lovBakedAt. A slot may carry `lov` while still being type=string — that is the pre-baked / bake-failed state (resolved as free text until re-baked on TTL or ServiceFormChanged). Keeping the descriptor lets the hybrid model re-fetch without re-reading Altiora's schema.

entityId.description: Altiora BI dictionary entity id (`dictionaryEntityId`), e.g. 'entity-dbo-lk_dutystations' or an 'intg:<guid>' integration source.

displayFieldIds.description: BI field ids concatenated into each option's label (`dictionaryDisplayFields`, falling back to the single `dictionaryFieldId`).

valueFieldId.description: BI field id whose value becomes the stored option value (`dictionaryValueField`). When absent, the label doubles as the value.

filters.description: Static dictionary filters (`dictionaryFilters`) narrowing the option set, mapped to FormLookup's flat filter shape.

operator.description: FormLookup operator: eq | neq | contains | startswith. Defaults to eq.

typeahead.description: Hint that the dictionary is too large to present as a closed choice list and should be served via the typeahead directory endpoint (I-6) rather than baked options. Advisory; not yet consumed.

lovBakedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last successful LOV bake (I-4b). Drives TTL-based re-fetch in the hybrid model. Present only on slots whose `lov` was resolved into presentOptions.

groupable.description: Whether this slot may be asked together with adjacent groupable slots in one turn (batched question). Default false.

dependsOn.description: slotIds that must be filled before this slot is asked. Enforces intra-flow ordering without topology.

promptHint.description: Natural-language hint the QUESTION_PLANNER uses to phrase the ask. The planner may only ask for slots in this snapshot (CODEX-RULE-077).

dictRef.description: P1-12 — CASCADE dictionary: this field's value is looked up from an Altiora dictionary FILTERED by another slot's value (e.g. staff name/grade/duty station resolved from an index number). Resolved during the conversation, once every `filters[].slotId` is filled — unlike `lov`, which is baked at materialization. Only faithfully expressible filters are carried; anything else is dropped so the slot degrades to manual entry.

displayFieldIds.description: Dictionary columns shown to the user when confirming the resolved row.

valueFieldId.description: Dictionary column taken as the slot value; defaults to the display column.

filters.description: Cascade conditions. Every entry depends on another slot, so they also drive `dependsOn` ordering.

operator.description: Only equality is implemented; anything else drops the descriptor (fail-closed).

slotId.description: Slot whose value supplies the filter — must be filled first.

multi.description: Enum slots only: the field accepts MORE THAN ONE of its presentOptions (Altiora checklist/multiselect), so the slot value is an array of option values rather than a scalar. Default false (single-select).

helpText.description: Field guidance carried from the source form (Altiora `description`, plus `placeholder` as a labelled example). Grounds the QUESTION_PLANNER's phrasing and FIELD_HELP answers. Machine artifacts (e.g. 'Auto-generated field for …') are filtered out at materialization (TASK-PROMPT-005).

section.description: Stable slug of the Altiora form SECTION this slot belongs to (from FormField.sectionId → the referenced type='section' field). Sections are the form author's semantic grouping (avg ~3 fields each); carried so the dialogue, the graph (SlotGroup) and the KB description can group related questions. Layout-only; never a slot itself.

sectionLabel.description: Human label of the slot's section (the section field's label), for question grouping headings and KB description structure.
